claims.text: Long-term prophylaxis: lanadelumab (kallikrein inhibitor), SC or IV C1 inhibitor, berotralstat (kallikrein inhibitor); androgens (limited by toxicity) and tranexamic acid (limited by lack of efficacy)
claims.quote: Medications available for long-term prophylaxis include lanadelumab (a kallikrein inhibitor), subcutaneous and intravenous C1-inhibitor, berotralstat (a kallikrein inhibitor), androgens (limited use due to toxicity), and tranexamic acid (limited use secondary to lack of efficacy).

claims.text: Garadacimab (FXIIa-inhibiting monoclonal antibody): prophylaxis of HAE attacks, age 12 and older
claims.quote: ANDEMBRY is an activated Factor XII (FXIIa) inhibitor (monoclonal antibody) indicated for prophylaxis to prevent attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE) in adult and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older.

claims.text: Donidalorsen (prekallikrein antisense oligonucleotide): prophylaxis of HAE attacks, age 12 and older
claims.quote: DAWNZERA is a prekallikrein directed antisense oligonucleotide indicated for prophylaxis to prevent attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE) in adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older.
